none: PAS CAM-271685: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy Radiate of Tetricus II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Radiate of Tetricus II. AD273-274, (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads SPES PVBLICA. Reverse shows Spes advancing left holding flower and skirt. Mint is Gaul Mint I. See Normanby p.197, no.1526. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]CAES. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.7g, diameter is 16mm
